title: Mixed Duo #028 · 여 V자 피지크·CarnivalGlam / 남 피트니스 모델·블랙 스모키 윙
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a tin square-sided cowbell, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead miniature anvil, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin small flared temple bell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a confident smirk, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, a tin cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver rings. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
